boundaries.callbacks: Unchanged independent Laurent heads; no callback execution
boundaries.geometry: Existing abstract inputs; geometry/denominator/source-projection construction excluded
boundaries.masters: No master values in weight dependencies; recovery alone uses symbolic Laurent components
boundaries.staging: Three actual evaluators; boundary values are parameters, not recomputed expressions

candidate_composition_bytes.scope: Cumulative substituted expression text plus output text per candidate; reference/recovery composition excluded; not resident memory

composition_budget_scope: Each candidate stage, reference composition, and integrated recovery has its own cumulative 8 MiB cap; not a global memory bound
identity_budget_scope: One cumulative 8 MiB cap across all exact-row identity groups
limitations: Exact symbolic equality does not validate numerical overflow, conditioning, Dual zero masks, or failure semantics.
The one-shot path requires eligible pure callbacks or an explicit changed callback contract.
Stage boundaries permit parent checks but do not implement callback eligibility, cut-stop, diagnostics, or transactionality.
Temporary sums are not peak memory; buffer packing and output writes are not measured.
No arithmetic count is a runtime or performance claim.
